mechanism_narrative: Higher federal funds rates compress equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 20-day returns when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% are positive.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns < 0.05 in the triggered regime (FEDFUNDS>4.5), or average 20-day returns when FEDFUNDS>4.5% are positive.

mechanism_narrative: The joint effect of a high federal funds rate and elevated unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.0) indicates recessionary risk, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS * UNRATE) has rank correlation with 20-day returns < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window, or average 20-day returns when the interaction is above median are positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (defined by UNRATE < 4.5 and INDPRO > 100), rising retail sales (RSAFS > 700,000) indicate strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime (UNRATE<4.5 and INDPRO>100), rank correlation between RSAFS and 20-day returns < 0.05, or average 20-day returns when RSAFS>700,000 are negative.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates stronger economic activity, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank correlation between INDPRO and 60-day returns < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 60-day returns when INDPRO>100 are negative.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals economic weakness that increases equity risk, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank correlation between UNRATE and 5-day returns < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 5-day returns when UNRATE>5.0 are positive.

mechanism_narrative: The joint effect of strong employment (PAYEMS > 159,000) and rising housing starts (HOUST > 1300) indicates a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (PAYEMS * HOUST) has rank correlation with 5-day returns < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window, or average 5-day returns when PAYEMS>159000 and HOUST>1300 are negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0), rising employment (PAYEMS > 159,000) indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the low-unemployment regime (UNRATE<4.0), rank correlation between PAYEMS and 60-day returns < 0.05, or average 60-day returns when PAYEMS>159000 are negative.
